loadError: The endpoints could not be loaded
readOnly: You can view these settings. Changing them needs the api:update permission.
staleRevision: Someone else changed this API's endpoint settings while you were editing. The latest settings are loaded; review them and try again.

noSpec.title: No OpenAPI document
noSpec.message: This API was not created from an OpenAPI document, so it has no endpoint list to govern. The gateway proxies its whole upstream under the listen path.

summary.version: Specification version {version} · {count, plural, one {# endpoint} other {# endpoints}}

restrict.label: Only allow declared endpoints
restrict.offHelp: Off: every path under the listen path reaches the upstream. Endpoint settings apply only to the endpoints they are set on.
restrict.onHelp: On: only the endpoints in the specification answer. Everything else gets 403 from the gateway.
restrict.boundary: Only this mode is a hard boundary. With it off, a control applies to the path exactly as spelled (plus its trailing-slash and upper/lower-case variants), so other spellings, such as a path with ;parameters, still reach the upstream.
restrict.methods: It also blocks methods the specification does not declare, including HEAD, which the gateway does not add automatically. CORS preflight (OPTIONS) is still answered.
restrict.tooMany: Not available: the gateway can manage at most {max} endpoints for one API.
restrict.confirmBody: Only the {count, plural, one {# endpoint} other {# endpoints}} in the specification will answer. Every other path and method will get 403 from the gateway once it syncs.
restrict.onToast: Only declared endpoints are allowed now
restrict.confirmOffBody: Undeclared paths and methods will reach the upstream again once the gateway syncs. Endpoint settings then apply only to the paths as spelled.

orphans.title: {count, plural, one {# setting} other {# settings}} for endpoints no longer in the specification
orphans.help: The gateway no longer applies these, because the endpoints left the specification. They are kept so nothing is lost silently.
orphans.confirmBody: This deletes the settings of {count, plural, one {# endpoint} other {# endpoints}} that are no longer in the specification. It cannot be undone.

table.selectPage: Select all endpoints on this page

bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# endpoint selected} other {# endpoints selected}}

notFor.cache: GET only, and not while the API has an API-wide cache

bulk.appliesTo: Applies to {count, plural, one {# selected endpoint} other {# selected endpoints}}.
bulk.savedToast: {count, plural, one {# endpoint updated} other {# endpoints updated}}
bulk.tagScope: Apply to all {count, plural, one {# endpoint} other {# endpoints}} tagged {tag} (ignores the search)
bulk.confirmBlockBody: {count, plural, one {# endpoint} other {# endpoints}} will answer 403 and never reach the upstream once the gateway syncs.
bulk.confirmPublicTitle: Allow these endpoints without a key?
bulk.confirmPublicBody: Anyone will be able to call {count, plural, one {# endpoint} other {# endpoints}} without a key or token once the gateway syncs.

governance.title: Endpoint settings
governance.enabledHelp: Off: the gateway answers 403 and never calls the upstream. Other methods on the same path are not affected.
governance.publicHelp: Callers need no key or token for this endpoint, even though the API requires one.
governance.rateLimitHelp: Answers 429 once the limit is reached within the window.
governance.rateLimitShared: This limit is one counter shared by all consumers, not a limit per key. One busy client can use it up for everyone.
governance.timeoutHelp: Answers 504 when the upstream takes longer.
governance.sizeLimitHelp: Answers 400 for a request body larger than this.
governance.cacheHelp: Serves repeat GET requests from the gateway cache without calling the upstream.
governance.mockHelp: Answers with this response and never calls the upstream.
governance.headersHelp: One per line, as name: value
governance.validateHelp: Answers 422 for a JSON body that does not match the schema, without calling the upstream.
governance.schemaHelp: Inline JSON Schema. $ref is not allowed; the gateway rejects it.
governance.notProven: Not offered: not proven to be enforced by this gateway version.

methodOnly.validateRequestSchema: Only for POST, PUT and PATCH endpoints.

governance.cacheApiWide: Not available while the API has an API-wide cache (Designer, Response cache).
governance.unavailableTitle: {count, plural, one {# gateway control not offered} other {# gateway controls not offered}}
governance.unavailableHelp: The gateway accepts these, but they were not proven to be enforced on this version, so they cannot be set per endpoint.
governance.saveError: The settings could not be saved
governance.removeOnly: This setting is stored but no longer offered. You can only remove it.

errors.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}
errors.statusCodes: Enter HTTP status codes (100-599), separated by commas
errors.headerLine: Each line needs a name, a colon and a value
errors.schemaTooLarge: The schema is larger than 64 KB
errors.schemaNotObject: The schema must be a JSON object
errors.schemaHasRef: Remove every $ref: inline the referenced schema instead
errors.bodyTooLong: The body can have at most {max} characters

source.label: OpenAPI document
source.help: OpenAPI 3.x, JSON or YAML, UTF-8 text, up to {mb} MB. UTF-16 files are not supported.
source.required: Choose a file or paste a document
source.tooLarge: The document is larger than {mb} MB
source.readError: The file could not be read. Save it as UTF-8 text and try again.

import.title: Import an OpenAPI document
import.description: Creates an API from the document. Nothing is created until you confirm.
import.recheck: The document or the settings changed. Check again before importing.
import.cannotImport: This document cannot be imported yet
import.conflict: An API with this slug or listen path already exists. Enter a different slug below and check again.
import.slugOverrideHelp: Leave empty to use the one derived from the title. It also sets the listen path.
import.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens
import.serverNoDefault: a server variable has no default
import.previewError: The document could not be checked
import.error: The API could not be imported
import.slugTooLong: The slug can have at most 100 characters

specUpdate.title: Update the specification
specUpdate.description: Compares a new document with version {version} before anything changes. Settings of endpoints that stay are kept.
specUpdate.recompare: The document changed since the comparison. Compare again.
specUpdate.unchanged: Identical to the stored version: nothing to apply.
specUpdate.removedGoverned: {count, plural, one {# endpoint with settings is removed.} other {# endpoints with settings are removed.}} The gateway stops applying those settings; they stay listed as stale settings until you remove them.
specUpdate.acknowledge: I understand that these endpoints' settings will stop applying
specUpdate.stale: The specification or its settings changed since you compared. Compare again.
specUpdate.error: The specification could not be updated
specUpdate.removesGoverned: Endpoints with settings would be removed, and the settings changed since you compared. Compare again.
specUpdate.firstDescription: Attaches the OpenAPI document as this API's endpoint inventory. Nothing changes on the gateway until you govern endpoints.

httpErrors.400: The request was refused as invalid.
httpErrors.403: You do not have permission to do this.
httpErrors.404: This API or its specification no longer exists.
httpErrors.409: This conflicts with the current state. Reload and try again.
httpErrors.415: The document was sent in a format the server does not accept.
httpErrors.422: The document was refused. Fix the problems listed and try again.
